## Event insurance doesn’t have to be a headache.

Venues require it, exhibitors forget it, and organizers chase COIs until the week before showtime. Vertical Insure makes event and exhibitor liability insurance built-in, instant, and verified right inside registration and planning workflows.

##### NEW

## AI-Powered COI Validation

Whether exhibitors purchase a pre-validated policy through Vertical Insure or upload their own, our AI-powered engine ensures compliance in seconds:

- Exhibitors upload any COI
- AI scans event insurance requirements
- AI verifies the COI meets coverage limits, additional
- insured wording, dates and more
- Exhibitors get instant approval or guidance on what’s missing

![](https://verticalinsure.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Screenshot-2025-12-08-at-10.52.09-AM.png)

## Double the Coverage, Zero the Stress.

#### Event Liability Insurance



#### Coverage for bodily injury and property damage that may occur during the event



#### Up to $1,000,000 in liability coverage per incident, with up to $2,000,000 total



#### Includes a Certificate of Insurance (COI) and waiver of subrogation



#### Automatically names the event venue as additional insured

starts at:

$95 / one-day event

#### Exhibitor & Vendor Liability Insurance



#### General liability coverage up to $1,000,000 per occurrence ($2,000,000 aggregate)



#### Protection against third-party claims of injury or property damage



#### Instant certificate generation with venue named as additional insured

starts at:

$49 / one-day event

## Make event insurance part of the experience.

Insurance shouldn’t stall your registration process or your show floor. With Vertical Insure, it becomes automatic, compliant, and already handled long before exhibitors arrive.
